baseProjector.incomingState: first-occurrence canonical equality pattern of the previous four identities, left-padded with START only when boundary positions are retained; current identity excluded
baseProjector.segment: Hebrew verse or glyph line; transitions never cross segment boundaries

claimBoundary: V17 localizes sensitivity of the previously observed V15 cross-corpus structural correspondence. It does not establish translation, semantic identity, historical contact, common authorship, theological identity, phonetic equivalence, causal mechanism, or machine execution. Passing ablations are diagnostic robustness results on previously opened lanes, not fresh independent confirmation.

boundary.description: retain only positions with four real predecessors and a real successor; removes START padding and END outcome

frequency.description: allow a Hebrew↔glyph candidate pair only if train within-corpus operator-frequency percentiles differ by at most 0.15

proper.description: exclude from Hebrew pairing any lemma having any proper-noun-tagged occurrence anywhere in the train partition

seenNew.description: collapse SEEN_EARLIER_SEGMENT and NEW_SEGMENT to OTHER while preserving END when boundary positions remain

segment.description: restrict to 6–10 item segments and cap each accepted segment at three deterministic hash-selected eligible events

evaluation.freshnessBoundary: holdout/control were previously opened in V10–V16; V17 is a frozen diagnostic localization study, not fresh independent confirmation

localizationRule.baselineRequired: if baseline fails, adjudicate BASELINE_NOT_REPRODUCED_UNDER_V17 and do not attribute failure to a stress control
localizationRule.cumulativeFirstBreak: first failing cumulative rung after the passing baseline/previous rung; boundary_only is cumulative rung 1 as well as the isolated boundary control
localizationRule.isolatedSufficientBreaker: if baseline passes, an isolated control is sufficient-to-break when that isolated variant fails full two-lane adjudication

evaluation.variantPass: a variant passes only if it has at least the frozen minimum pair count and both holdout and control independently pass evaluability and every lane gate

hebrewSource.properNameMask: OSHB morphology may only mark whether a Hebrew lemma has any proper-noun-tagged occurrence in the train partition; morphology never enters a fingerprint or score
hebrewSource.tokenIdentity: first numeric lemma component rendered H<number>

question: Which V16 stress control, applied alone or cumulatively, is sufficient to destroy the V15 Hebrew↔glyph anonymous operator-fingerprint transfer?

training.pairSelection: mutual nearest neighbor by weighted cosine similarity inside each variant; frequency candidate restriction only in variants containing the frequency control
